provenance: Actual shipped BattleRoomsScreen, BattleScreen, rankedHttp, rankedService and battle engine over authenticated loopback HTTP backed by an isolated memory store. Legal catalog-derived six-Pokemon loadouts; genuine three-entrant tournament bye and four-entrant round-robin schedule. Real damaging moves with Mega Evolution and Dynamax; setup forfeits are genuine API actions recorded in actions, never simulated HP/results. Static sprite CDNs allowed and all visible img/SVG image resources verified. Read-only observation hooks only. No production account/database or game source edits.
